departments.name: Delivery & Logistics Operations
departments.function_summary: Manages route optimization, rider dispatches, parcel sorting, linehaul transit, and resolution of delivery delays or transit failures across all provincial hubs.

departments.name: Billing & Accounts
departments.function_summary: Oversees Cash-on-Delivery (COD) reconciliation, merchant payment disbursements, tariff disputes, corporate invoicing, and fuel surcharge queries.

departments.name: Returns & Refunds
departments.function_summary: Coordinates reverse logistics, Return to Origin (RTO) processing, failed-delivery return verification, and customer reimbursement authorizations.

departments.name: Warranty & Claims
departments.function_summary: Investigates parcel loss, high-value shipment damage, cargo insurance claims, and merchant compensation settlements.

departments.name: Customer Relations
departments.function_summary: Serves as the primary touchpoint for general inquiries, VIP customer care, corporate account management, and overall satisfaction tracking.

departments.name: Account Security & Fraud Prevention
departments.function_summary: Monitors fraudulent COD collection attempts, portal account breaches, unauthorized profile alterations, and counterfeit shipping manifests.

departments.name: Compliance & Legal Affairs
departments.function_summary: Handles regulatory compliance, contract violations, prohibited cargo violations, consumer court notices, and dispute resolutions under trade laws.

departments.name: Safety & Risk Management
departments.function_summary: Evaluates operational hazards, dangerous goods mishandling, fleet vehicle accidents during transit, and warehouse safety incidents.

departments.name: Management Escalations
departments.function_summary: Resolves multi-department deadlock complaints, executive office referrals, severe brand reputation risks, and unresolved tier-3 grievances.
